'''Virujansi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Virujansi system/Legends|Virujansi system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The planet's populace had a complex hierarchy.

==History==
Colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] sometime during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the planet Virujansi was the site of a conflict known to history as the [[Virujansi Uprising]], a conflict eventually put down by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_2.html|Point/Counterpoint: Military Creation Act}}</ref> The planet was located along the [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]].<ref name="Atlas" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Virujansi and neighboring systems were defended by the Republic's [[Fourth Outer Rim Army]] of the greater [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Despite the protection, Virujansi fell victim to invasion by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the [[Virujansi Rarefied Air Cavalry/Legends|Rarefied Air Cavalry]] began to defend the planet, taking their [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] deep into [[borecrawler]] caverns to route the Separatist invasion forces. The local [[Battle of Virujansi|resistance movement]] was bolstered by the arrival of Republic forces led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who gladly flew alongside notable native pilots such as [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Following the battle and the successful routing of Separatist forces, the natives declared Jedi Skywalker the ''[[Warrior of the Infinite]]'', a title the Jedi would carry throughout the war.<ref name="I75" />

When the Clone Wars came to an end, Virujansi came under the jurisdiction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as the Old Republic was replaced by a new order. Early on, the Empire rained fire down on the unruly residents of Virujansi, burning crops and villages alike. Local rebellions sprung up, led by Garven Dreis and other veterans of war, seeing the deaths of countless citizens as they opened fire on the ground and in the sky against the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The world's local hero, Garven Dreis, escaped the planet and served the Alliance as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. the World would later become an Imperial Fortress.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Society and culture==
The planet of Virujansi was governed by a hierarchical caste system, ruled from the top by a [[Rajah]]. This individual was assisted by a series of different government officials such as the People's Advisor, who served as a liaison between guests and the Rajah. Other such advisers were the Mouth of Ancestors, a legal consultant who reviewed the planet's precedential laws; the Wrathor, a disciplinarian who reported the Rajah's views of displeasure; the Eye of History, a [[Historian/Legends|historian]] who reviewed problems in historical context; and the Conciliator, who was tasked with hammering out compromises between all parties.<ref name="SWRC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref>
